Rebuild a fresh answer-free working state from only the question, inference protocol, indexed current evidence, and framework-owned last-focus receipt. Output 1-3 decision requirements. Each requirement is {id,objective,videos,status,evidence_indices}. status is open, supported, or contradicted. An open requirement is a decision-critical uncertainty that still needs observation. Mark supported or contradicted only when the cited current evidence directly settles that requirement; every non-open requirement needs at least one evidence index. evidence_indices contains at most 2 unique integers selected from the supplied evidence_reference_catalogue. Never copy or invent provenance ID strings. videos must be nonempty and contain only supplied video IDs.

Review the last Focus against its stated evidence goal. outcome=resolved when a newly observed event directly settled the local goal, partial when new evidence narrowed but did not settle it, no_gain when it produced only a gap, repeated known detail, or failed to discriminate competing interpretations, and conflict when newly observed events support incompatible interpretations. If last_focus_receipt.force_open_requirement is true, retain at least one open requirement for the required follow-up stage. A partial, no_gain, or conflict review must also retain an open requirement while last_focus_receipt.visual_calls_remaining_after_focus is positive. Otherwise retain an open requirement whenever any decision-critical ambiguity remains; use only supported/contradicted requirements when the evidence state is answer-ready. A reserved or proposed complementary probe is a review obligation, not a conclusion: carry its unresolved substance into an open requirement when current evidence has not addressed it.

review.evidence_indices must contain at most 2 unique integers from last_focus_receipt.review_evidence_indices. outcome=resolved or conflict must use an index from last_focus_receipt.new_event_evidence_indices; a gap can support only partial or no_gain. This review grounding is independent of requirement status: a Focus may settle its stated local goal while revealing a new open decision requirement.

Preserve competing interpretations when evidence does not distinguish them. A local observation cannot imply whole-video or cross-video absence. Do not turn a plausible workflow prior into an observed transition. Use only comparable clocks and source-preserving identities. Do not output an answer, confidence, action, or prior reasoning.
